messages:
kevin: Noticed embedder v5.8.0 canary at 10% in us-central is showing steady memory growth across replicas, leading to 503s on warmup. Can we pause and decide rollback vs pin?

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout started: embedder v5.8.0 -> 10% us-central at 1788888870. Health: degraded, errors: 1.1% (baseline 0.05%), p99 +300ms, OOMs observed on 2 pods.

ops-maya: Thanks Kevin. Can you drop the quick graf link?

kevin: https://monitoring.redwood/internal/d/embedder-canary  — heap profile shows linear growth after ~2k requests, nodegroup alpha-2 affected.

lina: If it's memory growth during warmup we should avoid spreading this. Recommend immediate hold and regional rollback for us regions. Pin us-central to v5.7.2.

omar: Agreed. Also suggest we reduce canary to 0% traffic (drain) in us-central and leave APAC/EMEA canaries untouched for now.

product-julie: Quick question: will pinning require revising the published release notes for v5.8.0? We already sent them to customers.

kevin: Pinning is a routing override; it doesn't retract the release notes, but we should append a note: "us regions paused due to memory regression; investigating."

ops-maya: Command I'll run to pin and drain: ```sh
redwood routing override --svc embedder --region us-central --target v5.7.2 --drain-canary --reason "memory growth OOMs during warmup"
```

lina: Rollback/runbook thresholds:
- Immediate regional rollback if errors >= 1.5% sustained for 3m OR OOMs observed on >1 pod within 5m.
- Full global rollback if errors >= 2.0% sustained for 5m OR p99 > 1s for 10m.
- If memory growth traced to libjit/alloc path, hold release globally until patch.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Routing override ticket #ROUTE-61422 created by ops-maya. Pending execution.

ops-maya: I'll execute now and attach heap profiles to the ticket.

(20s)

ops-maya: Executed: us-central pinned to v5.7.2 with canary drained. Verified stable nodes serving traffic; two canary pods terminated during drain. p99 dropped toward baseline in ~50s. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Good catch. Leaving logical canary config at 10% but drained in us-central. HOLD on any percent bump in other US regions. APAC and EMEA canaries continue under watch.

omar: Assigning to infra/serving and infra-memory for heap/profile triage. I'll add a flag to capture jemalloc stats and enable verbose GC logging on canary pods in APAC.

product-julie: I'll update the release notes entry and send a short customer-facing line: "Partial rollout paused in US regions due to memory regression; investigating."

lina: Also recommend creating a short postmortem-if-escalated template in the ticket in case we need a rollback statement.

ops-maya: Added heap dumps and logs to #ROUTE-61422, assigned to @omar and infra-memory. Setting alert for rollback thresholds.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary status changed -> REGION-ROLLED-BACK (us-central) by ops-maya at 1788889140.

kevin: ack. Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if APAC shows the same growth and then push full rollback. For now, US pinned and monitoring.
